about: 10 sample site notes with the fields we expect. Text fields use keywords (all must appear, case-insensitive; a|b = either); null means the worker did not say it.

samples.transcript: Room 3 on the second floor, there's a crack in the wall next to the window. Needs to be fixed by Friday, high priority. Tell the plasterer.
The socket in room 12 is broken, we need new ones.
Please order 20 bags of cement for Friday.
Um, there's water leaking from the ceiling in the basement. It's urgent, the plumber needs to come today.
The scaffolding on the north side is loose. Nobody should go up there until it's fixed.
Paint the hallway on the third floor tomorrow, low priority, the painter can do it.
Im Raum 12 ist die Steckdose kaputt, bitte bis morgen reparieren. Der Elektriker soll kommen.
Bitte 50 Säcke Zement für Freitag bestellen.
Im zweiten Stock fehlt das Geländer an der Treppe. Das ist gefährlich, dringend!
Die Fliesen im Bad von Wohnung 4 sind gerissen. Der Fliesenleger soll das nächste Woche anschauen, mittlere Priorität.
